## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

Ejercicio 1 - El paso previo a across()

```{r}

alumnos <- data.frame(
  nombre = c("Ana", "Luis", "Juan"),
  matematica = c(8, 6, 9),
  historia = c(7, 8, 5),
  geografia = c(9, 7, 10)
)

```

```{r}
alumnos |> mutate(p_matematica = (matematica / 10) * 100,
                  p_historia = (historia / 10) * 100,
                  p_geografia = (geografia/10) * 100 
                  )

```

```{r}
alumnos2 <-  alumnos |> mutate(across(c(matematica, historia, geografia),
                                      .fns = \(.x) (.x /10) * 100,
                                      .names = "p_{.col}"
                                      )
                               )
```




```{r}
paises <- data.frame(
  pais = c("A", "B", "C"),
  hombres = c(100, 80, 120),
  mujeres = c(110, 90, 130)
)

paises |> mutate(p_hombres =  hombres / (hombres + mujeres) *100,
                 p_mujeres =  mujeres / (hombres + mujeres) *100 
                 )
paises2 <- paises |> mutate(  across (.cols = c(hombres, mujeres), 
                                      .fns = \(.x) (.x/ (hombres+mujeres)*100) 
                                      .names = "p_{.col}")
                              )

```
